description: The MERLIN and Dammed Fish projects publish 11,557 River Restoration Units for European sea-outlet basins. Universities in Lisbon, Vienna and Duisburg-Essen provide drainage-area, watercourse and basin layers, accompanied by tables describing units, typology and links to member states. The 2025 Zenodo release uses shapefiles and relational or CSV tables in a compressed archive, freely available under CC BY 4.0. These continental units support river-connectivity and restoration-planning simulations while allowing aggregation of heterogeneous environmental inputs. Coverage selects basins with at least one Strahler-order-three segment and inherits errors from the CCM2 network. Software access is separate from these data. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: River Restoration Units
notes: G4-0378; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
